content.name: Siobhan Gallagher
content.title: Ward Manager (Band 7), Acute Medical Unit
content.summary: NMC-registered adult nurse with 14 years in acute and elderly medicine, the last six managing a 28-bed Acute Medical Unit with 62 staff. I lead with data and kindness: under my leadership the unit cut agency spend by £214,000 a year and reached zero category 3–4 pressure ulcers for 19 consecutive months.

experience.title: Staff Nurse (Band 5), Elderly Care
experience.company: Kirkgate Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
bullets: Cared for 8 frail older patients per shift on a 30-bed elderly medicine ward, many with delirium, dementia or complex discharge needs.
Became the ward's dementia champion and introduced 'This is Me' profiles, which were completed for 85% of eligible patients within six months.
Completed mentorship training and supported 11 pre-registration nursing students through their placements.

experience.title: Senior Staff Nurse (Band 6), Respiratory Medicine
experience.company: Kirkgate Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
bullets: Ran shifts as nurse in charge on a 24-bed respiratory ward with a 4-bed non-invasive ventilation bay.
Delivered NIV competency training to 26 nurses, enabling the ward to staff the NIV bay with its own team rather than borrowing from critical care.
Audited oxygen prescribing monthly and, with the respiratory consultants, raised compliance with prescribed target saturations from 54% to 91%.
Investigated 9 patient-safety incidents using root cause analysis and presented learning at the divisional governance meeting.

experience.title: Deputy Sister, Acute Medical Unit
bullets: Deputised for the ward manager across a 28-bed AMU admitting around 45 patients a day from ED and GP referrals.
Built the unit's first e-rostering templates in Allocate HealthRoster, reducing unfilled night shifts by 30% in the first quarter.
Coordinated the unit's response during the first COVID-19 wave, converting a 6-bed bay to a cohort area within 48 hours.

experience.title: Ward Manager (Band 7), Acute Medical Unit
bullets: Lead a team of 62 nurses, nursing associates and healthcare assistants and manage a £2.9 million annual pay budget.
Recruited 14 internationally educated nurses and built a 10-week OSCE preparation and pastoral programme; all 14 passed and 13 remain on the unit.
Cut agency nursing spend by £214,000 a year by creating an in-house bank pool and flexible self-rostering.
Introduced twice-daily skin bundle checks and SSKIN board rounds, achieving 19 consecutive months with no hospital-acquired category 3–4 pressure ulcers.
Took the unit from 'requires improvement' to 'good' in the trust's internal ward accreditation scheme within 18 months.

achievements.title: NMC registered nurse (Adult)
achievements.detail: Registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Council since 2011; revalidated in 2017, 2020, 2023 and 2026.

achievements.title: Trust Team of the Year (finalist), 2023
achievements.detail: Shortlisted for the AMU's international recruitment and retention programme.
